profile.headline: Senior System Engineer at TapHere! Technology, LLC Manassas VA, Evergreen CO, Tampa FL

company.name: TapHere! Technology (TapHere): Manassas VA, Evergreen CO, Tampa FL

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Support Combatant Command Intelligence Enterprise Management Office (CCI EMSO). Lead Web developer for the CCI EMSO main website. This website will be used to provide outside entities with content on what CCI EMSO does and can provide. Created the webpage for the Defense Intelligence Mission Area (DIMA) Architecture Federation and Integration Portal (AFIP). This website provides training, account request forms, links to all relevant applications and community collaboration pages for the Enterprise Architecture community. Create, develop and design all websites using Vue 3 for frontend development, tailwind CSS for styling and Nuxt for site framework. Collaborate and share developmental code using Gitlab. Manage tasks and user stories using Open Project.

positions.title: Senior System Engineer
positions.description: Develop, deliver, operate, and manage DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline supporting development, integration, test, operations and sustainment, including rapid, secure, and Agile development environments consistent with industry best practices, integration and automation of the program’s security posture and design, document, and implement towards the multi-enclave, multi-environment, and extendable PaaS solution.

positions.title: ISR Engineer
positions.description: Lead System engineer for the several Mission applications in support of DoD. Administer both Windows and CentOS system. Perform system administration duties, troubleshooting and testing as needed. Provided Customer support for all ISR customers to any CIO software tool that is in my portfolio.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Microsoft Products · Technical Support · Quality Assurance · VMware vSphere · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Infrastructure · System Deployment

positions.title: Sr. Systems Analyst
positions.description: Lead System Engineer for all Windows Servers for the Defense Intelligence Agency Common Operating Picture. Plan, develop and implement cost effective IT solutions for the COP infrastructure. Work with outside entities to bring more data feeds to enhance the Common Operating picture. Establish new network connections to include setting up firewall exceptions and IPSEC tunnels. Implement and manage Flight Control software. Implement PKI enablement for users to access the websites on classified networks. Write HTML and CSS code for website development. System Administrator ROME and OSCAR CentOS systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Products · Technical Support · Quality Assurance · Infrastructure · System Deployment

positions.title: Lead CMMA Engineer for Software Integration
positions.description: Managed team of integration engineers responsible for integrating several software applications into the Department of Defense Intelligence Information System (DoDIIS) baseline.  Responsible for managing schedules, assigning projects, as well as, conducting quality assurance of the product prior to forwarding through the accreditation process. Attended project management meetings providing technical expertise and guidance for each task assigned. Responsible for integrating all Microsoft patches into the DoDIIS baseline. Write visual basic scripts and create .msi/.msp executables for automated installation within the baseline. Managed all Collection Management Mission Application (CMMA) software through the Defense Intelligence Agency Accreditation process. Used VMware for testing of all applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Products · Technical Support · Quality Assurance · System Deployment

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description: Traveled to remote countries, to include Pakistan and Thailand, to install immigration system software (PISCES)into local airports. Install and troubleshoot Solaris 8, Windows XP, Oracle 8i and 9i, as well as Weblogic and Java. Established relationships with Foreign Government Nationals to gain access to needed locations to install and maintain the PISCES systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Products · Technical Support · Networking · Infrastructure · System Deployment

positions.title: Helpdesk Engineer for National Security Council (White House)
positions.description: Worked for the National Security Council at the White House. Provided helpdesk duties for all Executive Assistants to the President and all the directors. Created accounts and troubleshoot problems in Windows XP and Windows 2003 server, using Active Directory. Project lead of System wide upgrade and user migration from Windows NT server to Windows 2003 server. Also upgrading 300 desktop systems to Windows XP. This was done within a 1month timeframe. Required to be completed by inauguration. Other tasks included managing all directors cell phones/blackberries, setting up high level VTCs and supporting the White House situation room.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Products · Technical Support · Infrastructure · System Deployment

positions.title: Configuration Manager
positions.description: Contract Officer Technical Representative(COTR) for many local Bosniac companies for the Army to include local cell phones for all Army officers and all copier contracts for Eagle Base, Tusla, Bosnia. Provided helpdesk support for a network of 3000 users on a Windows NT/2000 servers.

positions.title: Electronic Technician III
positions.description: Responsible for all computer and network administration for the RSC in Ft. Bragg, NC. Rebuilt entire LAN system to upgrade from a 10 Base-T LAN to a 10 Base-2 LAN. Installed site with cable modem internet access improving productivity by 85%. Lead technician on Thermal Weapon Sight and secondary technician for MC4 (Medical Communication for Combat Causality Care) systems. Repaired and troubleshoot TRQ-32 Air conditioning systems and TSII MAP.

positions.title: Computer Specialist
positions.description: Install software and troubleshoot laptop and desktop computers at SPAWARSYSACT PAC. Assisted in the deployment of the Defense Messaging System. Provided status reports, installed and configured software. Organized conferences for DMS Program Reviews. Setup dial-up networking, LAN networking. Ordered computer equipment and other supplies. Assisted DMS Program Manager with financial documentation, to include, funding documents, statements of work, and overtime funding. Supervisor for data clerk and training personnel. Ensured all tasks were complete and training was successful.
